usedFor: ClearCRM keeps proposals and invoices, and Google Drive runs “Copy a File” or “Share File With Anyone” on new records.

bestTemplate.name: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It copies a file into a chosen folder with an optional new name, so each proposal starts from your document.

watchOut: “New Invoice” in ClearCRM checks a time window on a schedule, so match the window to how often it runs.
